judged_text: add_members calls group.add(user) for every CSV username with no check that the user is already a member, and the client never clears the add-members input after a successful add (the author's own TODO), so re-submitting an existing member inserts a second group_users join row. An admin who clicks the Add button again (the stale username is still in the input) or who types the name of someone already in the group creates a duplicate membership: the user appears twice in the member list, user_count is inflated (group.users.count counts join rows), and cleanup requires manual DB deletion; there is no unique index on group_users to raise an error.
